_comment: Cloudflare Cache Rules for the LEO widget CDN. Atlas trace: DO-3B62F38E. Apply to whichever zone hosts the widget FQDN configured in WIDGET_PUBLIC_HOST (e.g. widget.leo-ai-audit.healthcarecopilot.ai). Apply via the Cloudflare Rules > Cache Rules UI in that zone, or via the Cloudflare API (POST /zones/{zone_id}/rulesets). Each rule has a stable 'description' so they can be diffed in code review. Path-based expressions are host-agnostic; you can change WIDGET_PUBLIC_HOST without editing this file.

rules.description: leo-widget-bundle: aggressive cache, immutable per release
leo-widget-manifest: short edge TTL, must-revalidate so CSO rollback propagates within 60s
leo-widget-advisory: short edge TTL, must-revalidate so CSO advisories propagate within 60s
leo-widget-default-deny: any path outside the widget surface MUST 404 from origin (defence in depth)

_security_settings_to_apply_separately._comment: browser_check / 'are you human' interstitial MUST be disabled on this zone -- the widget is loaded by other web apps, not by humans browsing directly, and a JS challenge would break every embedding host.
